title: NexPoint Real Estate Finance, Inc. Announces Series A Preferred Stock Dividend
summary: NexPoint Real Estate Finance, Inc. (NYSE: NREF) (the "Company") today announced a dividend for its 8.50% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock (NYSE: NREF PRA) of $0.53125 per share. The dividend will be payable on October 26, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 15, 2026.
